name: Interaction Design Principles
description: Foundational ergonomics, mental models, feedback loops, and usability heuristics for human-computer interfaces.

topics.title: Jakob Nielsen's 10 Usability Heuristics
topics.notes: Walkthrough of visibility of system status, match between system and real world, error prevention, and recognition over recall.
topics.why_it_matters: Provides a universally respected framework for spotting usability issues before user testing even begins.

topics.title: Visual Hierarchy, Spacing & Typography
topics.notes: Scale, contrast, whitespace, grouping (Gestalt laws), and typographic scales to guide human eye scanning.
topics.why_it_matters: Users scan web interfaces in F-shaped and Z-shaped patterns; clear hierarchy ensures immediate comprehension.
